name: Yanagi Hiromi
source:
[url=https://vndb.org/c30121]Sae[/url]'s best friend seems like the least likely type of person to work in a bunny uniform. She wears glasses and seems a bit insulated. She especially lacks confidence when it comes to interacting with guys. Fortunately, she has no problems opening up to [url=https://vndb.org/c59928]Yukari[/url]!

[From [url=https://www.gamefaqs.com/pc/580736-do-you-like-horny-bunnies/faqs/33784]Ben Woodhouse's Walkthrough[/url]]
